items.title: Steve "Ted" Brown Interview, 1958-04-22
items.q: Freddie Grofey wrote a number out... He told me out there, he said, Brown, I'm gonna write a number, slap at the bass. He wrote it, and I don't know what... orchestrations, I guess he could get the bass players to play it much

ctx.x: I used to think that was good. Still good. Huh? Still good. Still good. Huh? Still good.
Still good. Freddie Grofey wrote a number out. Do you remember slapping the bass? Yeah, that's a good one. I used to think that was good. Still good. Huh? Still good. Still good. Still good.
